description:
Programme Overview

The Tsinghua University Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) 2027 is a fully funded award covering tuition, on-campus accommodation or housing subsidy, monthly stipend of CNY 3,000 (Master's) or CNY 3,500 (PhD), and comprehensive medical insurance. Applications are made through two possible tracks: Type A via Chinese embassies or Type B directly through Tsinghua.

Two Application Tracks

  • Type A (Bilateral Program / Embassy Track): Apply to the Chinese Embassy or Consulate in your home country. Windows run roughly November 2026 to February 2027, varying by country. Apply online at campuschina.org selecting Type A and your country's agency number.
  • Type B (Chinese University Program / Tsinghua Track): Apply directly through Tsinghua University's international graduate admission system. Select Chinese Government Scholarship as scholarship type and B as agency number. Only one Type B submission per university is possible.

Financial Coverage

  • Full tuition fee waiver for entire program duration.
  • Free on-campus university accommodation or housing subsidy.
  • Monthly living stipend: CNY 3,000/month for Master's students; CNY 3,500/month for PhD students.
  • Comprehensive medical insurance approximately CNY 800/year.
  • Not covered: international airfare on most tracks; MBA programs and most MBBS programs excluded.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Non-Chinese citizens holding valid foreign ordinary passport.
  • Good health, both mentally and physically.
  • Age limits: under 35 for Master's applicants; under 40 for doctoral applicants.
  • Academic qualifications: Bachelor's degree for Master's admission; Master's degree for doctoral admission.
  • Language proficiency: HSK Level 5 or above for Chinese-taught programs; IELTS 6.0+ or TOEFL 80+ equivalent for English-taught programs.
  • Meet program-specific requirements (GMAT/GRE for management, portfolio for design, etc.).

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Tsinghua application portal opensMid-October 2026
Type A embassy deadlinesNovember 2026 - February 2027 (country-specific)
Tsinghua program deadlinesDecember 2026 - February/early March 2027
University reviewMarch-May 2027
CSC final resultsJune-July 2027
EnrollmentSeptember 2027

Application Process

  1. Identify your program in the Tsinghua International Graduate Program Catalog.
  2. Prepare supervisor contact for PhD applications.
  3. Complete Tsinghua's online application and pay application fee (RMB 800 per program).
  4. Complete CSC online application at campuschina.org with Type B and Tsinghua's agency number.
  5. Submit all supporting documents to both portals.
  6. Wait for university review and CSC nomination.
  7. CSC final review with results announced June-July 2027.

Required Documents

  • CGS Application Form (from CSC portal)
  • Tsinghua University International Graduate Application Form
  • Passport information page
  • Highest diploma/degree certificates (notarized)
  • Academic transcripts (notarized)
  • Language proficiency certificates (HSK or IELTS/TOEFL)
  • Study plan / research proposal
  • Two recommendation letters
  • Foreigner Physical Examination Form
  • Non-criminal record certificate
  • Application fee receipt
  • Optional: publications, awards, supervisor acceptance letter

Fields of Study

Tsinghua offers CSC-eligible programs across 53 schools and departments including Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Economics and Management, Public Policy, Law, Architecture, Arts and Design, and Natural Sciences. At least 30+ graduate programs taught fully in English.

Official Links

  • Tsinghua Graduate Admissions: https://yz.tsinghua.edu.cn/en
  • Tsinghua CGS Scholarship Application: https://yz.tsinghua.edu.cn/en/info/1027/1117.htm
  • CSC Official Portal: https://www.campuschina.org

Important Notes

  • Some programs close in December 2026 (notably Tsinghua SIGS Shenzhen programs).
  • Type A embassy deadlines are earlier and country-specific.
  • Applying through both Type A and Type B is possible in parallel.
